name: Talents
overview: The Bible teaches that God entrusts each believer with unique talents and gifts according to His grace and ability, as seen in the parable where servants receive varying amounts of talents to steward (Matthew 25:14-15). These talents represent not only material resources but also spiritual gifts and abilities, which are to be used faithfully and diligently (Exodus 35:10; Romans 12:4,6). The responsibility to develop and multiply these God-given talents is emphasized by the call to actively employ them for the kingdom, with unfaithfulness leading to loss and redistribution (Matthew 25:28). This underscores the diversity of gifts within the body of Christ and the importance of using them according to the measure of faith given.
